name: Nullharbor
notes: Fold white-flash: #space is a transparent desynchronized canvas so an uninitialized GPU swap composites over the dark CSS background instead of paper-white. 2.15.7 already filled after resize, but an opaque buffer still presented #fff for a frame when a hitch stalled the next submit.

Sky wash bake happens before the main-buffer fill. Allocating a full-viewport OffscreenCanvas (resize, leave-station, first cruise frame) can evict the main buffer; filling after that alloc closes the race that showed NPC ships on a white field.
Resize ignores 1–2 device-pixel visualViewport jitter. Launch / jump warms planet albedos and the sky layer so the first in-view traffic cluster is less likely to hitch.
Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.2. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2. Flight menu Update still clears farbound-* caches and reloads.
